question: What direct vision of the all-pervading hero within the body is decisive?
premises: There is an Akula hero dwelling in the body.
One may directly see that hero.
inference: Direct vision of the all-pervading Akula hero within the body is a decisive realization.
uncertainties: The compound akula vīram may be read as a title or as two qualities; taken as the Akula hero.
plain_english: When one sees the all-pervading Akula hero dwelling in the body.
